rule: A CALL is one `coverage-verdict` commitment in the option-wizard ledger carrying the target run's `runId`. The renderer mints exactly one per supporting-coverage row the author called with a scorable, non-`untested` token on a row that has a datum and is not renderer-filled (plugins/option-wizard/render/review.ts:1227-1253), so the count is the register's own, not a re-parse of the printed table.
